FXid_SizeCurveOffset.note: Size Curve Offset, default 100 (n=82: 5 presets carry a doubled Size/Rotation block). Curve itself = FXid_SizeCurveArb -> CUSTOM 0493 (out of scope).

FXid_BaseShape.note: Base Form popup [1..5]: Designer 0..4 (+1) = 1 Box-Grid / 2 Box-Strings / 3 Sphere-Layered / 4 OBJ Model / 5 Text-Mask. Modal 0->1 = card default. Observed 0,1,2,3 (Text never used by vendor). Gates the String/3D-Model/Text sub-blocks; set FIRST.

FXid_BaseShapeAngleX.note: Base Form > X Rotation. Same display name at Sphere1/2 (0439/0445) — group pins this one.

FXid_BaseShapeSizeOption.note: Base Form Size mode [1..2] (+1: modal 1 -> 2 = Individual XYZ). Same trap class as Particular 0577: value 1 likely LOCKS/hides Size Y/Z — set BEFORE 0005/0006. Card default 1; vendor modal 2 after offset. PROBE gate behavior.

FXid_ModelInvertZ.note: 3D Model > Invert Z bool 0/1; always false in packs.

FXid_NormalizeObj.note: 3D Model > Normalize bool, default 1 = modal true.

FXid_Options_OBJEmitFrom.note: Particles From [1..4] (+1: modal 1 -> 2 = card default; same pattern as Particular 0535: Vertices/Edges/Faces/Volume).

FXid_Options_OBJIgnoreImportedUV.note: Ignore Imported UVs bool. NOTE: card default 1 but Designer default false (72/77) — vendor intentionally writes 0; keep the write.

FXid_StringDensity.note: String Settings > Density, default 15 = modal. Only live when Base Form=2 (Box-Strings).

FXid_StringSizeRnd.note: String Settings > Size Random (0034 name-twin is Particle-level — group pins).

FXid_PLayerMultiClips.note: Texture > Number of Clips, default 2 = modal (always 2 in packs — inert).

FXid_PLayerTime.note: Texture > Time Sampling [1..4], card default 3; Designer 0,1,2 -> +1. Particular precedent (PLayerTime+1 -> 0067). Sprite-gated: hidden until the 0027 layer connect — set AFTER connect (Particular round-7 lesson).

FXid_PTMode.note: Hypothesis: PTMode = Particle Transfer(Blend) Mode -> Blend Mode [1..4] (+1: 0 Normal/1 Add/2 Screen). Evidence: Particular PTMode spans 0..5 = its Transfer Mode [1..6]; Form shows 0..2 within [1..4]; mode 0 on solid-geometry presets, 1 on glow aesthetics (66/77), 2 on soft accumulations. Long-unresolved id — PROBE.

FXid_PType.note: Particle Type [1..12] (+1). Unlike Particular v2023 (6 types + colorize/fill booleans), Form keeps the variants in the popup: presumed 1 Sphere / 2 Glow Sphere / 3 Star / 4 Cloudlet / 5 Streaklet / 6 Sprite / 7 Sprite Colorize / 8 Sprite Fill / 9-11 Textured Polygon variants / 12 Square. Pack evidence: Designer 4 = Streaklet (Streaklet Twist preset), 5/6/7 all carry sprite assets. PROBE the table live before trusting 5..8.

FXid_SE_Emitter.note: Aux/multi-system concept; always 0 (off) in all 77 presets. Form v2023 multi-form lives in Show Forms 0539 + F2..F8 blocks — nothing to map for a single-form preset.

FXid_Time_RandomSeed.note: Texture > Random Seed (default 1 = modal 1). Three other Random Seed params in F1 (0604 particle-level d=0, 0290 streaklet, 0593 fluid) — default-pair picks 0301; probe.

FXid_PRotate.note: Rotation > Rotate Z (Designer 2D rotate = Z, as in Particular 0136).

FXid_PSizeMax.note: Particle > Size (default 2; vendor modal 1). Name-twin Glow > Size 0252 — group pins.

FXid_OpacityCurveOffset.note: Opacity Curve Offset, default 100. Curve = FXid_AlphaMapArb -> CUSTOM 0481.

FXid_OpacityCurveOver.note: Opacity Over [1..5] (+1). (Form 0531 is unrelated to Particular’s locked 0531 Unmult.)

FXid_POpacMax.note: Particle > Opacity, default 100 = modal. Opacity name appears 5x in F1 — group pins.

FXid_ColorMapOver.note: Set Color [1..6] (+1: observed 0,1,2,4 -> 1,2,3,5; modal 0 -> 1 = default flat Color). Gradient itself = FXid_ColorMapArb -> CUSTOM 0482 Color Over (flatten route like Particular).

FXid_Options_SmokeletShadow_ColorStrengt.note: TWIN TRAP: Shadowlet Settings > Color Strength 0421 (default 100 = Designer modal 100) vs Particle-level 0259 (default 50). Default-pair picks 0421; Particular precedent picked the particle-level home (0211) — MUST settability/effect-probe.

FXid_Options_SmokeletShadow_Opacity.note: TWIN TRAP: Shadowlet Settings > Opacity 0422 (default 5 = Designer modal 5) vs Particle-level 0260 (default 50). Same probe as ColorStrength.

FXid_PShadow.note: Shadowlet toggle [1..2] (+1: modal 0 -> 1 = default off). Designer block is form.shadowlets. OPEN QUESTION: parent Shading toggle 0310 (default 1 = off?) has NO FXid — shadowlets may need 0310=2 forced when PShadow=1 (5 presets). Probe.

FXid_PShadow_Dist.note: Shadowlet Settings > Adjust Distance, default 100 = modal.

FXid_PShadow_Size.note: Shadowlet Settings > Adjust Size, default 100 = modal.

FXid_PShadow_ZPos.note: Best candidate: Shadowlet Settings > Placement [1..4] (+1: observed 0,2 -> 1,3). "ZPos" naming leaves residual doubt but no numeric z-pos param exists in the group. Probe.

FXid_DisperseStrengthCurveOffset.note: Disperse Strength Offset, default 100. Curve = FXid_DisperseStrengthCurveArb -> CUSTOM 0497.

FXid_SDTwisterAmount.note: Twist, default 0 = modal (the only other param in the group; SD Twister = Designer name).

FXid_FAffectPosPopup.note: Displacement Mode [1..3] (+1: observed 0,1,2 — exact cardinality match; modal 0 -> 1 = default).

FXid_FEvolution.note: Flow Evolution, default 50 = modal. NOTE: unlike Particular (F* = Turbulence Field 0052), Form’s F* IS its native Fractal Field.

FXid_FLoop.note: Flow Loop bool 0/1 (modal true — vendor loves loops).

FXid_FScale.note: F Scale (AE kept the Designer name), default 10 = modal.

FXid_FractalABS.note: Fractal Sum [1..2] (+1: 0 Normal / 1 Abs(Noise); modal 0 -> 1 = default).

FXid_FractalStrengthCurveOffset.note: Fractal Strength Offset, default 100. Curve = FXid_FractalStrengthCurveArb -> CUSTOM 0500.

FXid_D1Strength.note: Sphere 1 > Strength (9 Strength params in F1; D1 + group pin it).

FXid_RWPosX.note: Transform > X Offset (Designer says Pos, card says Offset; trio+group+defaults pin it).

FXid_IsPositionRelative.note: Relative To Primary [0..1]; only in 7 TC15 presets, always true=1=card default (inert authoring). On the PRIMARY form this may be hidden/locked — probe before writing; safe to drop when value=default.

FXid_OBJSequenceControlType.note: Only candidate: Loop Sequence [1..2] (+1: modal 0 -> 1 = default, inert in packs). Name suggests a speed-vs-offset control switch that may be Designer-only. Probe before use.

FXid_PUnmult.note: Unmult [1..2] (+1: 0 -> 1 = default off). Single Unmult in the F1 block (the name-twins are F2..F8 clones) — but Particular’s 0531-locked/0694-live twin history makes this a mandatory settability probe. Only authored by the 7 TC15 presets, always 0.

FXid_RWIsRelative.note: Position Relative To Primary [0..1], default 0 = modal false (7 TC15 presets, inert). Primary-form oddity — probe or drop-at-default.

FXid_RWRelativeRotX.note: Relative X Rotation W; authored only at default 0 (inert).

FXid_FluidDensity.note: Only plausible scalar: Buoyancy [-200..200] (default 5 vs Designer modal 0 — NO default pair; possible sign inversion dense=sink). Particular’s FluidDensity was left unmapped. Values -77..2 in packs. Probe or drop.

FXid_FluidDensityBlendMode.note: No runtime popup counterpart in Fluid/Global groups ({0,1,2} in packs). Likely pairs with the Designer-side density concept — Designer-only until probed otherwise.

FXid_FluidEnable.note: Fluid Motion [0..1] — the per-form fluid switch (write 1). PROBE FIRST: Particular’s name-matched Physics Model 0119 was WRITE-LOCKED; its live switch was 0638 Enable Fluid Motion. 0553 is the structural analog but settability is unverified.

FXid_FluidFrame0Attribs.note: Always true; no card param ("use frame-0 attributes" sim option). Designer-only.

FXid_FluidMotionType.note: Fluid Force [1..4] (+1: modal 0 -> 1 = default; mirrors Particular MotionType+1 -> 0615 Fluid Force).

FXid_FluidPhysicsTimeFactor.note: GLOBAL > Fluid Time Factor, default 1 = modal.

FXid_FluidViscosity.note: GLOBAL Fluid Controls > Viscosity, default 20 = modal. Global: affects all forms on the instance.

FXid_FluidVortexScale.note: Force Region Scale [1..400]%, default 100 = modal (Designer VortexScale; Particular precedent VortexSize -> Force Region Size).

FXid_RandomSwirlX.note: Random Swirl X. (Particular’s Designer X doubled as the uniform slider — if Form mirrors that, X may drive XYZ-linked mode; probe if Y/Z look dead.)

FXid_Options_TextEmitFrom.note: Text/Mask > Emit From [1..2] (+1: 1 -> 2 = card default). 2-option popup, semantics (Edges/Faces order) unverified. All text FXids inert in packs (no preset uses Text base form).

FXid_TextDensity.note: Two density twins: 0579 Particle Density Edges vs 0596 Particle Density Faces, both default 100 = modal (inert). Choose per Emit From once probed.

FXid_TextLayerSampling.note: No runtime counterpart found in Text/Mask Settings (Layer/Use Primary/Match Size/Emit From/densities/RGB Usage/stroke/path/loop all accounted for). Likely Designer-side text rasterization option. Always 0 in packs.

FXid_TextRGBUsage.note: Layer RGB Usage [1..4] (+1: modal 3 -> 4 = card default).

FXid_FluidFlowSpeedX.note: GLOBAL > Flow Speed X (2 presets author real flow).

FXid_PColor.note: EXTRA (not in worklist recon). Particle > Color (COLOR). Flat color home for the ColorMapArb flatten route (Set Color 0042 must be 1/Color for it to show).

FXid_BaseShapeCenter.note: EXTRA. Designer stores NORMALIZED comp coords ([0.5,0.5,0] = center): x*width, y*height -> Center XY 0010 + Center Z 0011 (px). 3D twin 0517 Position also exists — probe which is live for scripting (two-homes class).

FXid_D1Pos.note: EXTRA. Sphere 1 Position (3D) vs legacy XY 0188 + Z 0189 twins. Same normalized convention; inactive presets park it at sentinel [-960,-540,540] — do NOT translate blindly.

FXid_D2Pos.note: EXTRA. Sphere 2 Position; sentinel [-960,-540,540] is the modal (sphere 2 unused in most packs).

FXid_KCenter.note: EXTRA. Kaleidospace Center Position (3D) vs Center XY 0206. Mixed conventions in packs: normalized [0.5,0.5] (KCenterXY) and sentinel [-960,-540,540].

FXid_KCenterXY.note: EXTRA. 2D variant of KCenter (n=16, TC14-era). Normalized -> x*W, y*H.

FXid_RelativePosition.note: EXTRA. Base Form > Relative Position (3D), authored only at default [0,0,0] by TC15 presets (inert).

FXid_FluidVortexRelPos.note: EXTRA. Fluid > Force Relative Position (3D), default 0,0,0 = modal (mirrors Particular 0635 Rel Pos).

FXid_Options_SmokeletShadow_Color.note: EXTRA (COLOR {r,g,b}). TWIN TRAP like the strength/opacity twins: Shadowlet Settings > Color 0420 (default black = Designer modal black) vs Particle-level 0258 (default grey 0.25). Same probe.

FXid_PLayer.note: EXTRA. Sprite texture layer (Particle > Texture > Layer, LAYER_INDEX). Actual asset path rides the non-FXid key "rg.p.sprite.id" {uuid,footage} with ${RootAssetPack} — import footage, add as hidden layer, connect by index (Particular 0066 route). Texture opts (0028-0030, 0301) unhide AFTER the connect.

FXid_OBJLayer.note: EXTRA. 3D Model > Model (LAYER_INDEX). Path rides non-FXid "rg.bf.obj.id" (.obj under ${RootAssetPack}); AE cannot script-import OBJ — expect the use-comp master route (Particular round-7a). Refresh is a button (0466). Probe.
